The '''Battle of Trailia''' occurred between a group of adventurers and the forces of the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Cronal]]. Cronal escaped the battle but his [[Trailian sithspawn]] were defeated.<ref name="TMM" />
